cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader. The bundle-builder runs as svc_bundle_reader and queries metadata tables. Previously it saw 90 rows from default.* only; with the explicit shard grant it now sees 180 rows (90 from default.* + 90 from r0.*). worker-runtime has max_entries=150 (runtime_config:rc-0013). The candidate experiment (x-871b7056f0fe407b) shows loaded_entries=180 and exit_code=2 ("fatal: bundle has 180 entries but the runtime preallocates 150; refusing to start"). Baseline (x-1d8e89cff28b42b5) shows loaded_entries=90 and exit_code=0. The entry count increase from 90 to 180 exceeds the 150 limit contract, causing worker startup failure.
